{
  "summary": "Implement triage.sh to group noisy logs into stable error signatures by extracting the error message pattern (removing variable parts like IDs), counting occurrences, and sorting by count descending. The script filters out INFO/WARN logs, extracts error signatures, groups them, and outputs in the format 'COUNT SIGNATURE'.",
  "files": [
    {
      "path": "scripts/triage.sh",
      "content": "#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

LOG_FILE="${1:-}"

if [[ -z "$LOG_FILE" || ! -f "$LOG_FILE" ]]; then
    echo "Usage: $0 <log_file>" >&2
    exit 1
fi

# Extract ERROR lines, normalize variable parts, count signatures
awk '
/ERROR/ {
    # Remove timestamp and level
    $1 = ""
    $2 = ""
    msg = $0
    gsub(/^[ \t]+/, "", msg)
    
    # Normalize variable parts: orderId=..., sku=..., providerTxnId=..., email=...
    gsub(/orderId=[0-9]+/, "orderId=XXX", msg)
    gsub(/sku=[a-zA-Z0-9]+/, "sku=XXX", msg)
    gsub(/providerTxnId=[A-Za-z0-9]+/, "providerTxnId=XXX", msg)
    gsub(/email=[^ \t]+/, "email=XXX", msg)
    
    signatures[msg]++
}
END {
    for (sig in signatures) {
        print signatures[sig] " " sig
    }
}
' "$LOG_FILE" | sort -rn
"
    }
  ]
}
